mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a current temperature of 56 degrees. We are under a waning crescent moon tonight with an overnight low of 49 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

City residents should note that the public works department has a new leaf vacuum truck for fall collection, and remember to place all loose leaves behind the curb. Additionally, the building inspection department is currently accepting permit applications for various residential and solar projects.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at trivia events at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from October 3, Verona police officers arrested a 19-year-old man who was found to be in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so you have plenty of time to stop by before they lock the doors at 10:00 PM tonight.
